label: Meiji Bulgaria
note: Japan’s best-known plain yoghurt; named LB81 after its two strains, L. bulgaricus 2038 and S. thermophilus 1131 (last digits 8 and 1)

about.text: A plain set yoghurt from the Japanese dairy Meiji, made with two defined strains of the yoghurt bacteria, which its name LB81 is built from.
